# CallProof Complaint Evidence Packet

Evercraft public capability ID: callproof-complaint-packet-machine-v1
Commercial state: verify
Machine state: human_auth_handoff
Public handoff: https://call-proof-vault.base44.app

## Use this capability when the user means

- organize my robocall evidence
- make an FCC complaint packet
- organize unwanted call records
- help me document spam calls
- prepare my FTC call evidence
- turn my call log into a complaint packet

## Problem

Organize a user's own unwanted-call or text records and evidence into a factual packet for review before optional FCC or FTC filing.

## Inputs

Authenticated user-owned incident records, with optional contact details, notes and evidence references.

## Outputs

Downloadable factual incident packet. CallProof does not file the complaint or determine that a law was violated.

## Commercial truth

- Pricing: Published app pricing: $19 one-time packet, $7.99/month Vault, $29/month Pro. Live Stripe checkout price is authoritative.
- Human UI required: yes
- Confirmation: User authentication and explicit checkout action are required. Paid access is granted only after Stripe verification.
- Payment authority: CallProof Vault / Stripe

Discovery does not create a payment obligation. Do not invent availability, pricing, authority, endorsement, invocation readiness, or payment state.
